reviews.title: Feels like a full-time job, Not a mobile Game
reviews.text:
Honestly, this game is garbage in its current state.

First off, the technical issues are unbearable. It’s extremely glitchy and crashes almost every 10 minutes like clockwork. You can barely get through a session without the game tearing itself apart.

Second, the progression design is ridiculous. There are way too many bloated, tedious systems just to get a slight bump in power. You have to individually level up hunters, manage endless gear, optimize builds, and track a million sub-menus. Nobody has time for this—it’s supposed to be a mobile game you play on the go, not a full-time job where you need a spreadsheet just to figure out what to upgrade next.

To top it off, the game throws 50 million tutorials and text boxes at your face that literally nobody reads. Bro, it’s WAY too much clutter.

Hell, even Diablo Immortal is more straightforward than this. At least Diablo lets you get straight to the point with a clear grind, instead of drowning you in useless mechanics and constant crashing.

Save your storage space and your sanity. Do not recommend.

reviews.title: DEVS FIX THIS
reviews.text:
It’s a really good game overall, the combat is amazing, the graphics are sick, and it’s super fun- BUT there are some huge problems. One is that it’s way too easy to get good stuff and level up. I’m level 45 with all SSR rated hunters and equipment but my missions are at LEVEL 18 and I can just one shot everything. 
And no, I haven’t been grinding without doing the story, I’ve just been claiming activity funds and doing gates, but it really takes away from the fun of the game since it’s too easy. 
The bigger problem is how often it crashes. The quality of this game IS RUINED BECAUSE OF HOW OFTEN IT CRASHES. I can’t go 2 minutes without being kicked out. I’ve tried to start this one mission 5 times and have crashed every time as soon as I change my hunters. 
It really sucks how good of a game it is that is completely ruined because of it crashing. 
Devs please fix this then the game will be perfect.

reviews.title: Lagging, freezing, and force closing
reviews.text: I believe the game has too much detail, graphics, and lengthy storyline for a mobile game. Even with more than enough storage up to date software and pretty new device the game lags, freezes, and force closes far too frequently (mid fight mostly) which takes away from the overall experience making it a negative one. The software of the game’s entirety needs to be redeveloped to be maintained on a mobile device or this game just needs to stay on console/pc. It would honestly be a 10/10 game without all of these issues but the frequency of it makes it hard to enjoy.
